2b5774cf663ff81315df052fd9950f3ede6e2162.sql:
SELECT
    e.equipmentcode AS Equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus AS "Heater Status",
    tswg.insulationstatus AS "Insulation Status",
    las.emergencylightstatus AS "Emergency Light Status",
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS "Structure Load",
    om.operationalstatus AS "Readiness Label"
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref
JOIN
    lightingandsafety las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref
JOIN
    location l ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref
JOIN
    weatherandstructure ws ON l.locationregistry = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
WHERE
    ws.structuralintegritystatus = 'Normal';

f2b7ac8880dc19227985d10996a3c48908765d11.sql:
SELECT
    e.equipmentcode AS equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus AS heater_status,
    tswg.insulationstatus AS insulation_status,
    las.emergencylightstatus AS emergency_light_status,
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS structure_margin,
    om.operationalstatus AS readiness_label
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref
JOIN
    lightingandsafety las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref
JOIN
    location l ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref
JOIN
    weatherandstructure ws ON l.locationregistry = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
WHERE
    ce.heaterstatus = 'On'
    AND tswg.insulationstatus = 'Good'
    AND las.emergencylightstatus = 'On'
    AND ws.structuralintegritystatus = 'Normal'
    AND om.operationalstatus = 'Active';

536039542e5487eec3c97054578eb926e85f2d86.sql:
SELECT
    e.equipmentcode,
    e.equipmenttype,
    om.operationalstatus AS status_category,
    (
        (ww.waterlevelpercent / 100.0) * 0.2
        + (ww.waterpressurekpa / 1000.0) * 0.2
        + (ww.watertemperaturec / 100.0) * 0.2
        + (ww.waterflowlpm / 1000.0) * 0.2
        + (ww.waterqualityindex / 100.0) * 0.2
    ) AS water_management_score
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    waterandwaste ww ON e.equipmentcode = ww.watereqref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref;

SELECT 
    e.equipmentcode, 
    e.equipmenttype, 
    e.equipmentmodel, 
    e.manufacturer, 
    e.reliabilityindex, 
    e.efficiencyindex, 
    e.safetyindex, 
    e.environmentalimpactindex, 
    ce.cabineqref, 
    ce.cabinclimate 
FROM 
    equipment e 
JOIN 
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref 
WHERE 
    ce.cabinclimate->>'temperature_c' BETWEEN '18' AND '24' 
    AND ce.cabinclimate->>'o2_percent' > '19.5' 
    AND ce.cabinclimate->>'co2_ppm' < '1000' 
    AND ce.ventilationstatus = 'On' 
    AND ce.heaterstatus = 'On';

SELECT 
    l.locationtype AS location_type, 
    l.stationname AS station_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.equipmentcode) AS num_equipment, 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tswg.renewablemetrics IS NOT NULL THEN e.equipmentcode END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.equipmentcode) AS reliance_on_renewables, 
    SUM(
        (
            (tswg.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::NUMERIC + 
            (tswg.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::NUMERIC
        )
    ) AS total_renewable_power, 
    e.equipmenttype AS classification 
FROM 
    location l 
JOIN 
    equipment e ON l.loceqref = e.equipmentcode 
LEFT JOIN 
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref 
LEFT JOIN 
    powerbattery pb ON e.equipmentcode = pb.pwrbatteqref 
WHERE 
    tswg.renewablemetrics IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
    l.locationtype, l.stationname, e.equipmenttype 
ORDER BY 
    l.locationtype, l.stationname;

    ((t2.waterlevelpercent * t2.waterqualityindex) / 100) * (1 - (t2.wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) AS water_management_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((t2.waterlevelpercent * t2.waterqualityindex) / 100) * (1 - (t2.wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) < 50 THEN 'Conservation needs immediate attention'
        WHEN ((t2.waterlevelpercent * t2.waterqualityindex) / 100) * (1 - (t2.wastetanklevelpercent / 100)) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Monitoring advisability'
        ELSE 'Sustainable management'
    END AS status_category
FROM 
    equipment AS t1
JOIN 
    waterandwaste AS t2 ON t1.equipmentcode = t2.watereqref;

065842a43cf90a430c8dbcc8bf12baa359025b36.sql:
WITH EnergyEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmentcode, 
        ((performanceindex + reliabilityindex)/2) * (1 - environmentalimpactindex/10) AS eer
    FROM 
        equipment
),
HighOSPI AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmentcode, 
        safetyindex * efficiencyindex AS osapi
    FROM 
        equipment
    WHERE 
        safetyindex * efficiencyindex > 0.75
)
SELECT 
    h.equipmentcode, 
    e.eer AS energy_efficiency_metric, 
    h.osapi AS OSPI_value
FROM 
    HighOSPI h
JOIN 
    EnergyEfficiency e ON h.equipmentcode = e.equipmentcode;

9f9a09c85b96f49f9821cc78c9dd5904355ec22f.sql:
WITH EquipmentRanks AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmenttype,
        equipmentcode,
        efficiencyindex,
        safetyindex,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiencyindex) AS efficiency_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY safetyindex) AS safety_rank
    FROM 
        equipment
)
SELECT 
    equipmenttype,
    equipmentcode,
    efficiencyindex,
    safetyindex,
    efficiency_rank,
    safety_rank,
    (efficiency_rank - safety_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM 
    EquipmentRanks
ORDER BY 
    rank_difference;

WITH RankedEquipment AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmenttype, 
        equipmentcode, 
        efficiencyindex AS overall_efficiency, 
        safetyindex, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiencyindex DESC) AS efficiency_rank, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY safetyindex DESC) AS safety_rank, 
        (DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiencyindex DESC) - DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY safetyindex DESC)) AS rank_difference
    FROM 
        equipment
)
SELECT 
    equipmenttype, 
    equipmentcode, 
    overall_efficiency, 
    safetyindex, 
    efficiency_rank, 
    safety_rank, 
    rank_difference
FROM 
    RankedEquipment
ORDER BY 
    rank_difference ASC;

WITH calc_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.equipmenttype,
        T1.equipmentcode,
        T1.efficiencyindex AS overall_efficiency,
        T1.safetyindex,
        (T1.safetyindex * T1.efficiencyindex * 0.8) AS overall_safety_performance_index,
        CASE 
            WHEN T2.operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - (T2.operationhours / T2.maintenancecyclehours))
            WHEN T2.operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - (T2.operationhours / T2.maintenancecyclehours))
            ELSE 0
        END AS operational_readiness_score
    FROM equipment AS T1
    JOIN operationmaintenance AS T2 ON T1.equipmentcode = T2.opmainteqref
),
rank_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY overall_safety_performance_index) AS ospi_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY operational_readiness_score) AS ors_rank
    FROM calc_scores
)
SELECT 
    equipmenttype,
    equipmentcode,
    overall_efficiency,
    safetyindex,
    ospi_rank,
    ors_rank,
    (ospi_rank - ors_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM rank_scores
ORDER BY rank_difference;

WITH readiness_metric AS (
    SELECT 
        opmaintregistry AS registry_id,
        operationhours AS usage_hours,
        maintenancecyclehours AS service_interval,
        operationalstatus,
        CASE 
            WHEN operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (operationhours / maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (operationhours / maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0
        END AS readiness_metric
    FROM 
        operationmaintenance
)
SELECT 
    registry_id,
    usage_hours,
    service_interval,
    operationalstatus,
    readiness_metric
FROM 
    readiness_metric;

1b1bf75685ea32659f38d4a6b3d4680e1eb223f0.sql:
WITH station_info AS (
    SELECT 
        l.stationname, 
        l.locationtype, 
        AVG(ww.waterqualityindex) AS avg_water_quality_index, 
        AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) AS avg_wrmi_score, 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tswg.powerqualityindex < 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS water_saving_systems_count, 
        'Water Quality Classification' AS water_quality_classification, 
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed' 
            WHEN AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised' 
            ELSE 'Sustainable Management' 
        END AS management_situation 
    FROM 
        location l 
    JOIN 
        waterandwaste ww ON l.loceqref = ww.watereqref 
    JOIN 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON l.loceqref = tswg.thermaleqref 
    GROUP BY 
        l.stationname, l.locationtype
)
SELECT 
    stationname, 
    locationtype, 
    avg_water_quality_index, 
    avg_wrmi_score, 
    water_saving_systems_count, 
    water_quality_classification, 
    management_situation 
FROM 
    station_info 
ORDER BY 
    stationname, locationtype;
